title: a CLAUDE.local.md that does not import AGENTS.md gets a warning and is never edited; with the import there is no warning
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup instructions, defect N-18): a delimited, reversible JITSO block in the instruction files agents read
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-18, setup instructions). `CLAUDE.local.md` makes Claude Code stop reading `AGENTS.md` when there is no `CLAUDE.md`. The command warns on stderr (`jitso: warning: CLAUDE.local.md stops Claude Code from reading AGENTS.md; add a line @AGENTS.md to it to keep the JITSO block`), still writes `AGENTS.md`, and leaves the local file unchanged. After the user adds the import line, the warning is gone. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.

stderr.equals: jitso: warning: CLAUDE.local.md stops Claude Code from reading AGENTS.md; add a line @AGENTS.md to it to keep the JITSO block

stdout.equals: jitso setup instructions: nothing to do (the JITSO block is up to date in AGENTS.md)
